title: Urban Game Theory — minimal agent proposal recipe
description: Body of POST /agent/proposals (x402-paid). Declare land with cadastreParcelIds, or give a site (or geometry of its own) for a material proposal on ground with no cadastral parcel. cadastreParcelIds must equal the server binding of the site (POST /agent/binding). agent.wallet and agent.paid are set by the server from the settled payment; author, if sent, must equal the paying wallet.

city.description: City id, e.g. zagreb, split, belgrade, new_york.

cadastreParcelIds.description: The parcels the proposal is bound to: exactly the parcels its site reaches into (POST /agent/binding answers binding.parcels). Empty is allowed for a material proposal (building, structure, road, readjustment) whose site lies on no cadastral parcel; never for a parcel act (offer, ownership transfer, vote, road designation).

site.description: The ground the proposal occupies: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon, EPSG:4326 (at most 100000 vertices, 500 km² bounding box). Optional: without it the site is the proposal's own geometry (or, for a parcel act, its declared parcels). The proposal's geometry must lie inside it.

toleranceM.description: Linear intrusion tolerance in metres: a parcel is bound when the site reaches into it by more than this width (the diameter of the largest circle inside site ∩ parcel). Default 0: any reach binds. Measurement error only, never a design allowance.

proposalId.description: Unique operation id. Reuse it, together with the same x402 payment identifier and body, for safe retries.

type.description: parcel | building | structure | road (free text, 50 chars).

goal.description: Semantic land-use goal. Formation goals include park, square, lake, station, road-track, single, buildings, and reparcellization. A park/square/lake/station/road-track forms public ground.

author.description: Omit, or your paying wallet's base58 address.

items.description: Base58 Solana public key of a lens member (an attester).

lens.description: The lens: public keys of the attesters whose SAS attestations (ParcelOwnership-v1, ProposalVerdict-v1) this proposal accepts. Pass the same list as the lens argument of mint_and_fund; it is immutable once minted (fork the proposal to change it). Pick members from GET /lenses/members; schemas at GET /lenses/schemas.

proposalRole.description: Omit for an ordinary proposal. owner-offer: the author is a lens-attested owner of the declared parcels offering its own land. Bids arrive as proposal_pledge pledges and donations (GET /agent/pledges/<proposal-account>), and the owner executes by signing accept_with_attestations for its parcels. Any other value is refused with 400.

offer.description: Amount offered to the parcel owners.

buildingProposal.description: A building massing in the app's stored shape; copy from GET /proposals?city=…&limit=5.

geometry.description: Top-level GeoJSON geometry for the proposal footprint.

structureProposal.description: A park/square/lake/station. Set kind and its GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry.

roadProposal.description: A road corridor in the app's stored shape.

facets.description: Authored terms. For public formations use ownership: to-city.

ownershipFlow.description: Publish-time effect stamp: area taken from each cadastral parcel and its destination. Public formations use destination: public.

cadastreFrame.description: When the ownership flow was measured.

effectHash.description: Fingerprint of goal + footprint + ownershipFlow. Acceptances bind to this effect.

agent.description: Free-form provenance kept on the record; wallet and paid are overwritten by the server.
